sharingGuestRules.description: Lets the feedback site guest user read only invitations that were actually sent: Sent On is stamped by GxFeedbackDispatch before the link leaves. The survey resolves a link by the secret on these rows, so without this it cannot tell which guest is answering - guest users see no records even in without-sharing Apex. Nothing about the person is exposed: the guest reads the invitation, never the Contact.
sharingGuestRules.label: Golf Extra Feedback - Guest Invitations
